residual_findings.title: P0 self-verification missed cargo check --workspace; nexus42 sqlx query! macro cache stale after workspace_sessions migration (PM pre-QC build blocker)
residual_findings.scope: crates/nexus42/src/commands/creator/mod.rs:1595 (creators INSERT) + crates/nexus42/src/commands/system/db.rs:85 (sqlite_master SELECT) — both query! macros fail to compile against .sqlx/ cache after P0 added workspace_sessions table migration 202606220002
residual_findings.note: Root cause: P0 added new table + queries in nexus-local-db; regenerated .sqlx/ cache for nexus-local-db-only macros but missed consumer crate macros (nexus42 imports nexus-local-db and uses query! macros on creators + sqlite_master tables). P0 self-verification ran cargo test -p nexus-local-db and cargo test -p nexus-daemon-runtime but did NOT run cargo check --workspace. Architectural lesson: any plan touching nexus-local-db migrations or new tables MUST run cargo check --workspace (or cargo test --workspace) in self-verification, not just the touched crate. PM will enforce this rule in future plan AC items (e.g. V1.56 P2/P3/P-last if they touch nexus-local-db).
residual_findings.closure_note: PM regenerated .sqlx/ cache via cargo sqlx prepare --workspace against a freshly-migrated SQLite DB. 2 new cache files added: .sqlx/query-24310e7f662c7c50c6821804d03720afb0651412952ed063ef25cdb87e43de73.json (creators INSERT) and .sqlx/query-3b17cf38385b3fc0e9cf25cbbc4f903bc9ab5d04aeeb2bdc10a7df73b50dacdd.json (sqlite_master SELECT). No existing cache files modified. cargo check --workspace clean post-fix.
